text:
Leo (AE): Starting POC with HelixMed next week. They want a 3-hour soak: sustained 450 qps, avg output ~1k tokens, p99 < 250ms, error <0.8%. Need run plan, quick sizing, and a cost delta for burst+multi-az. Can SE/SRE help?
Riya (SE): on it. Two clarifying q's: what percent of requests are streaming vs full-response? and how many unique prompts vs templated (cacheable)?
Leo (AE): 60% streaming, 40% full. About 40% of traffic repeats same prompt families (good cache hit).
Riya (SE): ok. Proposed test: warmup 20m, ramp 15m to 450 qps, steady 3h, cool-down 10m. Arrival pattern: piecewise Poisson + occasional customer-simulated surge: 3x for 45s every 30m. Models: rwd-6b-q8 (fast/cost), rwd-20b-q4 (quality), plus rwd-13b-8k (balance). Enable prefix KV cache and keep streaming enabled.
Riya (SE): sample load cmd:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-8k --target-qps 450 --duration 12000 --ramp 900 --warmup 1200 --burst-profile "every_30m:45s@3x" --concurrency 60 --payload-dist helix_prompts.json
```
Kai (SRE): infra notes: Dedicated pool recommended. Size for 520 qps steady headroom. Autoscale min=1, max=2 nodes, cooldown 90s. Turn on Multi-AZ for demo. Fallback rules: 6b->13b->20b? actually fallback should go to smaller model (6b) first to preserve latency. Also pre-warm KV and run a short cache-population pass before the main run.
Noah (Solutions): quick cost sketches: Dedicated node (rwd-13b-8k config) approx $900/hr to sustain 450 qps. 3h run+warmup ~= $2.9k. If we use hosted token billing rough estimate ~ $0.18 per 1k tokens inferred given quantization — will refine. Multi-AZ adds ~12% infra premium. Burst sizing (extra node for surges) +20% hourly.
load-bot: pre-run smoke output:
```json
{"test":"helixmed-prelim-2026-03-21","target_qps":450,"sustained_qps":452,"p50_ms":48,"p95_ms":138,"p99_ms":262,"error_rate_pct":0.5,"gpu_util_pct":86,"note":"p99 above 250ms on 13b-8k, try lower batch_delay or bump pool. 6b hit p99 ~198ms but quality TBD."}
```
Riya (SE): p99 262ms — slightly over SLO. Fastest mitigation: reduce max_batch_delay from 8ms to 5ms for this route, or add +25% Dedicated capacity. Lowering delay ups GPU ops. Which should we test first?
Kai (SRE): spin +25% capacity then rerun a 45m validation. If still over, tweak batch_delay. I'll schedule node spinup now.
Noah (Solutions): I'll prepare two pricing lines for the customer: (A) baseline with slightly larger pool (adds $270/hr) (B) smaller model fallback plan (rwd-6b) with quality caveats. Also attaching redacted SOC/sec answers in a follow-up DM.
Leo (AE): nice. Acceptance criteria for HelixMed: sustained 450 qps for 3h, p99 <250ms, <0.8% errors. If validation passes, demo on Wed. Keep updates here.
Riya (SE): running 45m validation at 450 qps in ~90m after config push. Will post short results.
load-bot: quick-post after 45m validation:
```json
{"test":"helixmed-val-2026-03-21","target_qps":450,"sustained_qps":451,"p50_ms":46,"p95_ms":130,"p99_ms":242,"error_rate_pct":0.4,"gpu_util_pct":78,"note":"p99 now 242ms after +25% capacity; meets <250ms. Next: confirm with customer trace and run full 3h soak."}
```
Leo (AE): great — that's within SLO. I'll coordinate final 3h soak with Helix and share scheduling options. Thanks team :tada:
